mapper.sql: FROM education_achievements a JOIN lecture_improvement_achievement_details d ON d.achievement_id = a.achievement_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = a.teacher_user_id

a.achievement_id, a.management_no, a.teacher_user_id, u.login_id AS teacher_name, a.organization_code, a.evaluation_year, a.management_item_code, a.achievement_date, d.performance_content, d.academic_year, d.semester_code, a.achievement_status, a.attachment_ref, a.created_at, a.updated_at

AND (
TRUE
FALSE
OR a.teacher_user_id = #{userId}
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM organization_user_mappings m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.organization_code = a.organization_code AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.effective_start_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND (m.effective_end_date IS NULL OR m.effective_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE) )
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM evaluation_organization_mappings p WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.business_type = 'FACULTY_ACHIEVEMENT' AND (p.data_scope = 'ALL' OR p.organization_code = a.organization_code) )
)
mapper.select: SELECT m.organization_code FROM organization_user_mappings m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.mapping_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND m.effective_start_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND (m.effective_end_date IS NULL OR m.effective_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY m.mapping_id LIMIT 1
mapper.sql: FROM detail_codes c WHERE c.group_id = 'SEMESTER' AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.system_use_yn = 'Y' AND (c.valid_start_date IS NULL OR c.valid_start_date <= CURRENT_DATE) AND (c.valid_end_date IS NULL OR c.valid_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE)
mapper.select:
SELECT c.code_value AS "code", c.code_name AS "name", c.additional_attributes::jsonb ->> 'academicYear' AS "academicYear"
ORDER BY c.sort_order, c.code_value

SELECT COUNT(*)
AND (c.code_value = #{semester} OR c.code_value = CONCAT(#{academicYear}, '-', #{semester})) AND (c.additional_attributes::jsonb ->> 'academicYear' IS NULL OR c.additional_attributes::jsonb ->> 'academicYear' = #{academicYear})
mapper.sql: FROM evaluation_management_items m JOIN evaluation_elements e ON e.element_id = m.element_id JOIN evaluation_items i ON i.item_id = e.item_id JOIN evaluation_areas a ON a.area_id = i.area_id WHERE a.area_code = 'EDUCATION' AND m.active_yn = 'Y' AND e.active_yn = 'Y' AND i.active_yn = 'Y' AND a.active_yn = 'Y' AND m.teacher_editable_yn = 'Y'
mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT m.management_item_code AS "code", m.management_item_name AS "name", e.evaluation_year AS "evaluationYear"
AND e.evaluation_year = #{year} ORDER BY e.evaluation_year DESC, m.management_item_code
mapper.update: UPDATE education_achievements SET management_item_code = #{row.code}, achievement_date = #{row.date}, attachment_ref = #{row.attachment}, achievement_status = #{row.status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{row.userId} WHERE achievement_id = #{row.achievementId} AND achievement_type = 'LECTURE_IMPROVEMENT' AND deleted_yn = 'N' AND achievement_status IN ('DRAFT', 'DEPARTMENT_REJECTED', 'CERTIFICATION_REJECTED')
mapper.sql: (SELECT c.code_value FROM detail_codes c WHERE c.group_id = 'SEMESTER' AND (c.code_value = #{body.semester} OR c.code_value = CONCAT(#{body.academicYear}, '-', #{body.semester})) ORDER BY CASE WHEN c.code_value = #{body.semester} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END LIMIT 1)
